root ::= "{" space v-kv "," space intent-kv "," space target-kv "," space set-kv space "}"

set-when ::= "\"" char{1,40} "\""

set-when-rest ::= ( "," space set-time-kv )? set-time-rest
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
target ::= "{" space  (target-rooms-kv target-rooms-rest | target-when-kv target-when-rest | target-time-kv target-time-rest | target-type-kv target-type-rest | target-subject-kv target-subject-rest | target-professor-kv target-professor-rest | target-reason-kv target-reason-rest | target-requester-kv )? space "}"
target-kv ::= "\"target\"" space ":" space target
target-professor ::= "\"" char{1,20} "\""
target-professor-kv ::= "\"professor\"" space ":" space target-professor
target-professor-rest ::= ( "," space target-reason-kv )? target-reason-rest
target-reason ::= "\"" char{1,100} "\""
target-reason-kv ::= "\"reason\"" space ":" space target-reason
target-reason-rest ::= ( "," space target-requester-kv )?
target-requester ::= "\"" char{1,20} "\""

target-rooms ::= "[" space target-rooms-item ("," space target-rooms-item){0,29} space "]"

target-rooms-kv ::= "\"rooms\"" space ":" space target-rooms
target-rooms-rest ::= ( "," space target-when-kv )? target-when-rest
target-subject ::= "\"" char{1,40} "\""
target-subject-kv ::= "\"subject\"" space ":" space target-subject
target-subject-rest ::= ( "," space target-professor-kv )? target-professor-rest
target-time ::= "\"" char{1,40} "\""
target-time-kv ::= "\"time\"" space ":" space target-time

target-type ::= ("\"수업\"" | "\"시험\"" | "\"휴강\"" | "\"빈강의실\"" | "\"특강\"" | "\"대여\"")
target-type-kv ::= "\"type\"" space ":" space target-type

target-when ::= "\"" char{1,40} "\""

v ::= ("1")
